newsitem.title: UK: Sterling intl bond volumes up 255 pct in 96 - ISMA.
newsitem.headline: Sterling intl bond volumes up 255 pct in 96 - ISMA.

text.p: The issuance of sterling denominated international bonds in 1996 rose to $51 billion equivalent, a 255 percent increase over the 1995 figure of $20 billion, the International Securities Market Association (ISMA) said.
It said in its annual report total new issuance volume for 1996 increased to $716 billion equivalent (Eurobonds and international issues) against $450 billion in 1995, a 59 percent surge.
Dollars accounted for $337 billion of primary market volumes after $146 billion in 1995 and $79 billion equivalent of mark bonds were issued compared with $89 billion the previous year.
ISMA said 30 different currencies were tapped in 1996.
